\section[(dialogue)]{People and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R150-first-pass-people-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for timid and bold.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a linen cloth, soap, a sponge, a water jar, a cup
  \item a fork, a plough, a bell, a flute, a lyre
  \item hard, soft, lukewarm, ancient, narrow
  \item low, thick, thin, blind, sharp
  \item sour, alive, gentle, fierce, pleasant
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A linen cloth? (\textbf{linteum, linteī}.) Soap? (\textbf{sāpō, sāpōnis}.) A sponge? (\textbf{spongia, spongiae}.) A water jar? (\textbf{urna, urnae}.) A cup? (\textbf{calix, calicis}.) A fork? (\textbf{furca, furcae}.) A plough? (\textbf{arātrum, arātrī}.) A bell? (\textbf{tintinnābulum, tintinnābulī}.) A flute? (\textbf{tībia, tībiae}.) A lyre? (\textbf{lyra, lyrae}.) Hard? (\textbf{dūrus, dūra, dūrum}.) Soft? (\textbf{mollis, molle}.) Lukewarm? (\textbf{tepidus, tepida, tepidum}.) Ancient? (\textbf{antīquus, antīqua, antīquum}.) Narrow? (\textbf{angustus, angusta, angustum}.) Low? (\textbf{humilis, humile}.) Thick? (\textbf{crassus, crassa, crassum}.) Thin? (\textbf{tenuis, tenue}.) Blind? (\textbf{caecus, caeca, caecum}.) Sharp? (\textbf{acūtus, acūta, acūtum}.) Sour? (\textbf{acerbus, acerba, acerbum}.) Alive? (\textbf{vīvus, vīva, vīvum}.) Gentle? (\textbf{mītis, mīte}.) Fierce? (\textbf{ferōx, ferōcis}.) Pleasant? (\textbf{iūcundus, iūcunda, iūcundum}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R150-second-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for annoying and useful.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item annoying, useful, clean, dirty, straight
  \item deaf, false, sure, safe, dangerous
  \item lucky, wretched, angry, quiet, purple
  \item dark, grey, golden, silver, wise
  \item careful, lazy, hard-working, timid, bold
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Annoying? (\textbf{molestus, molesta, molestum}.) Useful? (\textbf{ūtilis, ūtile}.) Clean? (\textbf{pūrus, pūra, pūrum}.) Dirty? (\textbf{sordidus, sordida, sordidum}.) Straight? (\textbf{rēctus, rēcta, rēctum}.) Deaf? (\textbf{surdus, surda, surdum}.) False? (\textbf{falsus, falsa, falsum}.) Sure? (\textbf{certus, certa, certum}.) Safe? (\textbf{tūtus, tūta, tūtum}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{perīculōsus, perīculōsa, perīculōsum}.) Lucky? (\textbf{fēlīx, fēlīcis}.) Wretched? (\textbf{miser, misera, miserum}.) Angry? (\textbf{īrātus, īrāta, īrātum}.) Quiet? (\textbf{quiētus, quiēta, quiētum}.) Purple? (\textbf{purpureus, purpurea, purpureum}.) Dark? (\textbf{fuscus, fusca, fuscum}.) Grey? (\textbf{cānus, cāna, cānum}.) Golden? (\textbf{aureus, aurea, aureum}.) Silver? (\textbf{argenteus, argentea, argenteum}.) Wise? (\textbf{prūdēns, prūdentis}.) Careful? (\textbf{cautus, cauta, cautum}.) Lazy? (\textbf{piger, pigra, pigrum}.) Hard-working? (\textbf{dīligēns, dīligentis}.) Timid? (\textbf{timidus, timida, timidum}.) Bold? (\textbf{audāx, audācis}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
